A '''medical capsule''' was a [[repulsorlift]] [[Hover-stretcher|stretcher]] that was used for the [[transport]]ing of injured individuals. One was used to keep the severely-wounded [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] on life support after his [[Duel on Mustafar|duel]] on [[Mustafar]] as he was flown to the [[Grand Republic Medical Facility|Grand Medical Facility]] on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Episode III" />
